description: Main implementation file for the prplMesh vendor message process, handling signal processing, logging, configuration, and event loop management.

methods.name: handle_signal
methods.description: Handles system signals for termination, log rolling, and ignoring unhandled signals.

methods.name: init_signals
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM, SIGINT, and SIGUSR1.

methods.name: init_logger
methods.description: Initializes and configures a logger instance, redirects stdout/stderr if enabled.

methods.name: start_vendor_message
methods.description: Creates and initializes a VendorMessageSlave instance.

methods.name: createDaemon
methods.description: Sets up the vendor message daemon, including logger, event loop, configuration, and main loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, handles configuration loading, initialization, and starting the daemon.
